layers.text: Subject: a charming little winter garden: one small square plot enclosed by a low rounded wall of packed snow blocks with pale blue shadows and an open gap at the front; inside grow, well apart, tall pointed ice-crystal plants in bright cyan and deep teal, two star-shaped violet-blue frost flowers and one round dark-green holly bush covered in bright red berries; a tiny snow lantern with a warm yellow glow sits on a corner of the wall. No cabbages; the snow has a blue-grey outline. Garden only.
